name: BogoMips
description: A crude measurement of CPU speed by the Linux kernel. This is NOT usable for performance comparisons among different CPUs, but might be useful to check if a processor is in the range of similar processors. As often quoted, BogoMips measures "the number of million times per second a processor can do absolutely nothing".
note: This is a pseudo-benchmark: BogoMips is a kernel-derived timing calibration value, not a measure of real workload performance. Scores do not correlate with application throughput and are not recommended for comparing instances or CPU generations.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
